## [1.7.5](https://github.com/Globberry/morphe-patches/compare/v1.7.4...v1.7.5) (2026-11-12)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* refresh repository metadata and README ([876a6af](https://github.com/Globberry/morphe-patches/commit/876a6afb2d9bb0206936473bf7af863590457a6e))

patches.name: PairIP License Check
patches.description: Neuters PairIP license verification so the app runs without a valid license.

patches.name: Pro Unlock
patches.description: Forces all Pro features enabled, keeps Pro active after signer checks, and unlocks Pro exports (including the paid-export receipt check).

patches.name: Signer Identity
patches.description: Forces the app's signer identity, signature checks, and signer-identity string to match the original publisher certificate.

patches.name: [Export] 12 Purchase Allow
patches.description: Always accept the paid-export purchase check (LP0JcGi9.MeOIJuj).

patches.name: [Export] 8 Diagnostics
patches.description: Log the whole export flow to logcat (tag KFPro). Read with: adb logcat -s KFPro

patches.name: [Export] 9 Toast
patches.description: Show a toast naming the reason the export was cancelled.
